map.提示：急性腹泻多由病毒(轮状/诺如)引起，多为自限性。血便需排查细菌性肠炎(志贺: Note: acute diarrhea is mostly viral (rotavirus/norovirus) and self-limiting. Bloody stool needs workup for bacterial enteritis (Shigella/Salmonella/EHEC). Rice-water stool needs cholera workup. Zinc shortens illness (10-20 mg/day ×10-14 days). Low-osmolarity ORS III is the first-choice oral rehydration salt. Antibiotics are not routine; used only for bloody stool/severe bacterial infection. This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.维持量=1000 mL/日(前 10kg×100)；中重度按缺失补累计量。: Maintenance = 1000 mL/day (first 10 kg × 100); moderate-severe add cumulative deficit.
map.血便提示细菌性肠炎，需培养；EHEC 慎用抗生素以防 HUS。: Bloody stool suggests bacterial enteritis, needs culture; avoid antibiotics in EHEC to prevent HUS.
map.前 10kg×100、10–20kg 部分×50、>20kg 部分×20 mL/: First 10 kg ×100, 10-20 kg portion ×50, >20 kg portion ×20 mL/day.
map.米泔水样便按甲类管理，大量快速口服/静脉补液。: Rice-water stool is managed as class-A; massive rapid oral/IV rehydration.
